instruction: Change the font color of the title on slide 2 to red.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to slide 2, opened View > Notes to add 'Team Members' as a note, then selected the title text and applied bold formatting. Completed in 15 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress slides, use View menu to access Notes view, type text in notes area, select title text, and apply font formatting (bold). Familiar with text selection and formatting toolbar.
metadata.task_rationale: Original task tested bold formatting. This variation tests font color change — requires selecting the title and using font color picker, a related but different formatting operation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide 2 title font color to red. Getter extracts the RGB color from title runs. Metric uses fuzzy color matching with Euclidean distance in RGB space (tolerance=30).

scoring_breakdown.color: 1.0 - Title font color is red (within tolerance)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide 2 (slide_index=1, 0-based) and identifies the title placeholder (placeholder_format.idx==0)
Getter properly extracts font color via run.font.color.rgb from the pptx file using python-pptx
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_color_rgb') without unwrapping 'rules'
Euclidean distance in RGB space with tolerance=30 is a reasonable fuzzy color matching approach for verifying red (FF0000)
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring getter reads the latest state
Minor issue: getter only checks the first non-empty run in the title; if the title has multiple runs with mixed colors, it won't detect partial color changes
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking all runs in the title to ensure the entire title text is red, not just the first run
